## User-visible change

Describe the feature, fix or documentation improvement.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests pass on the platforms this change supports.
- [ ] `python -B scripts/check_public.py` passes.
- [ ] Capability descriptions match the shipped code and examples.
- [ ] Documentation links resolve; no personal data or operational notes are included.
- [ ] Existing downloads are preserved; new artifacts have their own version and checksums.

## Limitations

State unsupported platforms, required opt-ins and integrations not exercised.
